name: strange-bloom-dev-tools
description: Developer tooling for STRANGE BLOOM · UNKNOWN SOILS. Players need nothing installed (open index.html). This manifest exists only to build generated runtime files: the portable runtime (dist/portable/: npm --prefix tools ci && npm --prefix tools run build:portable) and the plant sprite atlas (resources/plant-visual/generated/: npm --prefix tools run build:plant-art — Node built-ins only)
